final: SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanfeatures f JOIN sites s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY share DESC, f.zoneref LIMIT 10
